sentences.text: In 2024, the influence index stands at 28.2 for China (band 20.3–57.6, from 4 of six components) and 24.1 for the United States (band 19.2–55.9, from 4 of six components). The net lean is +4.1 points toward China.
Over the five years to 2024, the index for China rose by 7.6 points and the index for the United States fell by 9.7 points.

The value for China rests on trade export share, trade import share, debt stock and diplomatic alignment; every component is a recorded tie (trade shares, finance, debt, UN votes, legislative stance), not a judgement.

The value for the United States rests on trade export share, trade import share, finance flow and diplomatic alignment; every component is a recorded tie (trade shares, finance, debt, UN votes, legislative stance), not a judgement.
In 2024, 0.0% of Nicaragua's mineral exports (UN Comtrade value US$1.4 bn) went to China and 59% to the United States; together 59%, the rest to other destinations.
Since 2019 the share going to China was broadly flat and the share going to the United States fell by 41.4 points.
Relative to the 20-country export basket, its exports are specialised in gold (RCA 5.3).

2 sudden shifts in export shares are flagged from the customs data, the latest in 2023: Exports to the United States fell from 96% to 64% of the country's mineral exports between 2022 and 2023 (reported by NIC to UN Comtrade).

sentences.text: The AidData records show US$36 m of documented commitments from Chinese institutions to Nicaragua over 2013–2021 (4 events; the source ends in 2021).
The DFC and EXIM records show US$143 m of documented commitments from US institutions to Nicaragua over 2006–2019 (55 events).
Public and publicly guaranteed external debt owed to China was 0.1% of GDP in 2024 (World Bank IDS); no comparable series exists for debt owed to the United States.

The lenders with the largest recorded commitments to named recipients here are OPIC (predecessor of DFC) (US$117 m), Export-Import Bank of the United States (US$26 m) and People's Bank of China (PBC) (US$18 m).

sentences.text: In the UN General Assembly, voting agreement in 2024 was 87% with China and 18% with the United States.
Since 2019, agreement with China fell by 5.1 points and agreement with the United States was broadly flat.
Too few mineral-related legislative records naming either actor have been scored for a stance series (five per year are needed); the text model is zero-shot baseline, not yet validated.

After China: export controls on gallium and germanium items in force (MOFCOM/GAC Announcement 2023 No. 23 of 3 July 2023) (2023-08), the share of exports to the United States moved -37.8 points (96% before, 59% after); placebo p 0.14 against the series' other years (event list still in draft). An association, not a cause.

After China: export controls on graphite items in force (Announcement 2023 No. 39 of 20 October 2023) (2023-12), the share of exports to the United States moved -37.8 points (96% before, 59% after); placebo p 0.14 against the series' other years (event list still in draft). An association, not a cause.

After Inflation Reduction Act signed (H.R. 5376, 117th Congress): critical-mineral sourcing rules for the clean-vehicle credit (2022-08), the share of exports to the United States moved -37.1 points (98% before, 61% after); placebo p 0.15 against the series' other years (event list still in draft). An association, not a cause.

The published forecast for the share of mineral exports going to the United States in 2030 is 58% (90% band 1.8%–100%), from naive persistence, because no model beat it in backtests; the last observed year is 2024.

The published forecast for the influence index of China in 2030 is 30.7 (90% band 21.9–38.8), from random walk with drift partially pooled across countries (empirical Bayes), which beat naive persistence by 1% CRPS in backtests; the last observed year is 2024.

The published forecast for the influence index of the United States in 2030 is 23.7 (90% band 0.0–49.5), from damped local linear trend (Kalman filter, maximum likelihood), which beat naive persistence by 3% CRPS in backtests; the last observed year is 2024.

In 2025, unavailable components: trade export share and trade import share (no reported trade for the year); legislative stance (no scored legislative records naming the actor); debt stock (no source for debt owed to the United States); finance flow (source coverage ends 2021); debt stock and diplomatic alignment (source coverage ends 2024).

Source coverage ends at different years: Chinese official finance to 2021, US finance to 2026, debt by creditor to 2024, UN votes to 2024 and trade to 2025; components beyond a source's coverage are unavailable, not zero.

Stance values come from the text model (zero-shot baseline, not yet validated); the rest of this brief rests on official statistics and the registered databases, each cited on its chart.
